name: What Happens To Pastor That Lies
overview: Scripture clearly condemns lying, especially from those in spiritual leadership, as seen in the commandment against bearing false witness (Exodus 20:16) and the declaration that lying lips are an abomination to the LORD (Proverbs 12:22). Pastors who deceive and scatter the flock face severe rebuke from God (Jeremiah 23:1), and false witnesses will not go unpunished but will perish (Proverbs 19:9). The fear of God and upright living exemplified by Job (Job 1:1) stand in stark contrast to the sin of dishonesty, underscoring the high standard to which pastors are held.
